items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: when I got up there, they had Caypart and Fats and Big Jim

ctx.x: Okay, so you were with Kirk.

This is when I went back with Kirk. And I hear this big sound coming, floating out of the ballroom. And I said, 'Who in the hell is that?' I'm so amazed that Andy would have a trumpet player that played that pretty, because he thought Big Jim was the greatest thing that God ever created, and Big Jim was just a big, loud-playin' trumpet player...
